quote.text: “All human wisdom is summed up in two words: wait and hope.”
quote.author: Alexandre Dumas, The Count of Monte Cristo (1844)

stories.kicker: Ukraine · The shuttle that came home empty
stories.headline: A pause, not a peace
stories.dek: Two US envoys flew Moscow to Kyiv in a single weekend — the first face-to-face push in eight months. They left with a narrow truce over the two capitals and a proposal on the table. Zelensky’s own verdict: “the war will continue.”

stories.kicker: The regime · A hot number reopens the hike
stories.headline: The Fed’s hold, in question
stories.dek: One jobs print — three times what anyone forecast — turned next week’s meeting from a hold into a coin-toss. Thursday’s inflation number decides it. Higher-for-longer is back, this time as a hike.

stories.kicker: Down the rabbit hole · Vintage watches, the affordable end
stories.headline: The hunt for mechanical soul
stories.dek: You do not need six figures to collect vintage. The accessible tier — a 1970s Seiko chronograph, a tired Omega dress watch, the estate-sale find — is a whole world, and the entry fee is patience, not money.

stories.kicker: The air · A line crossed, then uncrossed
stories.headline: Unhealthy, for a day
stories.dek: For the first time in nearly two years the PSI tipped past a hundred. Then the wind turned. The number to watch is not Singapore’s reading — it is the hotspot count across the water.

stories.kicker: Buy it once · The rain layer
stories.headline: The weave, then the wax
stories.dek: Two philosophies wear the same word. One coats a natural cloth and beads the water off; the other bonds a membrane and breathes it out. Judge them by the oz, the layer count and the seam — and, in Singapore, by the honest admission that a great umbrella beats both.

stories.kicker: Chips · The money lists in Singapore
stories.headline: Nvidia buys a seat at the table it also owns
stories.dek: A US$3.9bn convertible bond, tied to the Nvidia–MediaTek partnership, lists on the Singapore Exchange today — and Nvidia is subscribing roughly nine-tenths of it. Vendor financing, or a genuine silicon marriage? Both.

stories.headline: A line of text, and nothing else
stories.dek: RayNeo’s iO landed at IFA at thirty-three grams, five hundred dollars, and — pointedly — no camera. After a season of see-through AR promises, the interesting glasses are the ones that promise less.

stories.kicker: Geneva · The house lets an outsider in
stories.headline: Bulgari’s first handshake
stories.dek: At Geneva Watch Days, the maker that owns the thinness records did the one thing it never had: handed its Octo Finissimo to an independent watchmaker. Vianney Halter’s retrofuture rework is a thirty-piece signal, not a product.

stories.kicker: Venice · Two Lions given, one withheld
stories.headline: The Lion that hasn’t roared
stories.dek: The 83rd Venice festival has handed lifetime Lions to George Clooney and Ellen Burstyn — but the one that matters, the Golden Lion for best film, is not awarded until the twelfth. So the honest report is the race, not the result.

stories.kicker: Primary Six · The countdown, in proportion
stories.headline: Three weeks that feel bigger than they are
stories.dek: As this issue prints, a 2014-born child is in the final run-up to the PSLE written papers. Here is the actual timeline, the scoring that decides the posting, and the reasons the whole thing matters a little less than the calendar makes it feel.

stories.kicker: The long game · Load, not the garment
stories.headline: The vest only works if you move in it
stories.dek: Weighted vests and rucking are 2026’s fitness trend — and the strongest new evidence is a caution. A year-long trial found the vest did nothing for bone unless the wearer actually walked and stood more while wearing it.

stories.kicker: What’s worth booking · The dated agenda
stories.headline: Book this week, plan the season
stories.dek: One general sale opens this week and is the most time-sensitive item on the page; one venue is finally confirmed. The rest is the season worth planning — every row re-checked against its official ticketer.

stories.headline: The country that will pay a stranger to be you
stories.dek: One Indonesian word — joki, “jockey” — now attaches to a stand-in for almost any obligation: a thesis, a video-game rank, a welfare application, and, since last year, your morning run. It is not a scam at the edge of the economy. It is a diagnosis of the whole thing.
